segments.source: About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,
segments.reference: Kintu Enoch bhi, jun Adam laga piche aha ekjon ase, taikhan nimite eneka bhabobani korise, aru koise, “Sabi! Probhu Tai laga hajar-hajar pobitro khan pora thaka khan ke loi kene ani ase.
segments.hypothesis: Enoch bhi, kun Adam pora sat-ta ase, taikhan nimite bhabobani korise, Sabi, Probhu Tai laga desh hajar pobitro manu khan logote ahise,

segments.source: to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an ungodly way, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.”
segments.reference: Tai sob uporte bisar kori bole nimite ahi ase. Kunkhan Isor pora bhal napa laga sob kisim laga beya kaam kori kene thaki ase, aru kiman paapi manu jun Isor ke bhoi nakori kene tai laga uporte bisi biya kotha koise, eitu khan sob laga uporte bisar kori bole nimite Isor ahi ase.”
segments.hypothesis: sobke bisar kori bole nimite, aru Isor pora biya kaam kora manu khan ke bisar kori dibole nimite, aru Isor pora biya kaam kora manu khan pora Tai uporte ki kotha koise, etu sob bisar kori dibole nimite.

segments.source: These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts—and their mouth speaks proud things—showing respect of persons to gain advantage.
segments.reference: Taikhan dusra logote khushi pora nathaka manu, hodai manu laga biya kotha koi thaka manu, nijor laga biya itcha te berai thaka manu khan ase. Taikhan laga mukh pora phutani laga kotha ulai thake, kun, nijor laga labh nimite dusra manu ke phusla laga kotha kori kene berai thake.
segments.hypothesis: Taikhan khushi kori thaka manu khan ase, taikhan nijor itcha nisena berai ase, aru taikhan laga mukh pora phutani kori thaka kotha khan koi ase. Taikhan pora manu khan ke bhal kori bole nimite bhal kotha koi ase.

segments.source: But you, beloved, remember the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
segments.reference: Kintu apuni, morom laga bhai khan, Probhu Jisu Khrista laga apostle khan pora age te ki koi dise eitu khan sob yaad koribi.

segments.source: They said to you, “In the last time there will be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.”
segments.reference: Taikhan pora apnikhan ke koise, “Duniya khotom hobole thaka homoi te misa kowa manu khan ulabo aru taikhan nijor laga biya itcha pichete he jabo.”
segments.hypothesis: Taikhan tumikhan ke koise, Hosor dinte misa-misi manu khan ahibo, taikhan nijor laga biya bhabona te berai kene.

segments.source: These are those who cause divisions and are sensual, not having the Spirit.
segments.reference: Eitu khan nimite he sob bhag hoi kene alag hoijai ase; taikhan duniya laga ase aru taikhan logote Isor laga Atma nai.
segments.hypothesis: Taikhan he manu khan ase jun khan bhitor te bhirodh kori bole nimite kaam kori ase, aru taikhan laga atma te thaka manu khan ase, aru Tai logote Pobitro Atma nai.

segments.source: But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.
segments.reference: Kintu apnikhan, morom laga bhai khan, dangor pobitro biswas pora apnikhan nijorke bonai lobi, aru Pobitro Atma pora prathana koribi.
segments.hypothesis: Kintu tumikhan, morom thaka khan, apnikhan nijorke pobitro biswas te dhuri kene thakibi, aru Pobitro Atma te prathana koribi.

segments.source: Keep yourselves in God’s love, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.
segments.reference: Apnikhan nijorke Isor laga morom te rakhibi, aru Jisu Khrista laga anonto jibon aru daya nimite rukhi thakibi.
segments.hypothesis: Isor laga morom te thakibi, aru amikhan Probhu Jisu Khrista laga morom bisari kene anonto jibon pabo.

segments.source: On some have compassion, making a distinction,

segments.hypothesis: Kunba khan uporte morom koribi, aru taikhan logote misa-misa koribi,

segments.reference: Kintu dusra manu khan ke jui pora ulaikene bachai lobi. Isor ke bhoi koribi aru dusra khan uporte daya koribi. Aru mangso laga itcha pora letera kora kapra ke ghin koribi.
segments.hypothesis: Aru kunba ke bachai dibo, aru bhoi pora jui pora ulai dibo, aru gaw laga kapra khan ke bhi nalagai dibo.

segments.source: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,

segments.hypothesis: Etiya Isor ke, jun pora taikhan ke girai bole naparabole paribo, aru apnikhan ke Khrista laga mohima usorte khushi pora thaki bole paribo,

segments.source: to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.
